name: CASSISS
fullName: Stenting Plus Medical Therapy vs Medical Therapy Alone for Symptomatic Severe Intracranial Atherosclerotic Stenosis
population: n=358, mean 56.3; 73.5% male, NIHSS TIA or non-disabling, non-perforator-territory stroke, enrolled beyond 3 weeks from the latest ischemic event; followed 3 years
finding: No significant difference between stenting and medical therapy
teachingPoint: Intracranial stenting added no benefit over medical therapy for symptomatic 70-99% stenosis, even with refined selection and experienced operators.
